questions.text: By whose commandment was Paul made an apostle of Jesus Christ (1 Timothy 1:1)?

options.text: By the decree of the council at Jerusalem that sent him unto the Gentiles
By the commandment of God our Saviour, and Lord Jesus Christ, our hope
By the elders of the church at Antioch that laid their hands upon him
By the letters of recommendation from Barnabas who brought him to Rome

questions.text: For what purpose did Paul beseech Timothy to abide still at Ephesus (1 Timothy 1:3)?

options.text: That he might distribute the silver to the poor and relieve widows
That he might build a new synagogue and establish daily sacrifices
That he might charge some that they teach no other doctrine
That he might dispute before the magistrates and plead for prisoners

questions.text: What is the end of the commandment according to 1 Timothy 1:5?

options.text: The exact knowledge of endless genealogies and traditions of the fathers
The outward observance of ceremonial laws and commandments of men
The honour from chief priests and worldly reputation among the people
Charity out of a pure heart, and a good conscience, and faith unfeigned

questions.text: For whom is the law made according to 1 Timothy 1:9?

options.text: For the lawless and disobedient, for ungodly and sinners
For the righteous and just who fulfil the whole precept
For the priests and Levites ministering in the sanctuary
For the rulers and magistrates executing worldly decrees

questions.text: Which two men made shipwreck concerning faith and were delivered unto Satan?

options.text: Philetus and Hermogenes
Hymenaeus and Alexander
Demas and Hermogenes
Diotrephes and Phygellus

questions.text: What does Paul exhort to be made first of all in 1 Timothy 2:1?

options.text: That they labour with diligence in merchandise for worldly profit
That they practice secret fasting and abstain from meat and drink
That supplications, prayers, intercessions, and thanks be for all
That they gather great stores of silver to build synagogues in Asia

questions.text: For whom must prayer be made that we may lead a quiet and peaceable life (1 Timothy 2:2)?

options.text: For the priests of the temple and all their ministers
For the wealthy merchants and all that traffic by sea
For the worldly philosophers and rulers of synagogues
For kings, and for all that are placed in authority

questions.text: Who is the one mediator between God and men according to 1 Timothy 2:5?

options.text: The man Christ Jesus
The high priest Aaron
The prophet at Sinai
The apostle at Rome

questions.text: How should women adorn themselves according to 1 Timothy 2:9?

options.text: In costly array with purple garments and pearls of great price
In modest apparel, with shamefacedness and sobriety of spirit
In gorgeous robes after the manner of proud worldly princesses
In continual sackcloth and ashes to be seen of mortal men

questions.text: Who was first formed and who was deceived according to 1 Timothy 2:13-14?

options.text: Eve was first formed, then Adam; and the man was first deceived
Both were formed together, and both were deceived at one moment
Adam was first formed, then Eve; and the woman was being deceived
Neither Adam nor Eve was deceived, but only the ancient serpent

questions.text: What does a man desire if he desire the office of a bishop (1 Timothy 3:1)?

options.text: He seeketh only worldly praise
He transgresseth civil decrees
He acteth contrary to the law
He desireth a truly good work

questions.text: What requirement concerning his household is given for a bishop in 1 Timothy 3:4?

options.text: One that ruleth well his own house and family
One that remaineth without children or a wife
One whose children dwell in the holy temple
One that committeth his household to strangers

questions.text: Why must a bishop not be a novice according to 1 Timothy 3:6?

options.text: Lest he through lack of learning mislead the whole flock of God
Lest being lifted up with pride he fall into the devil's judgment
Lest the secular magistrates apprehend him and bind him in bonds
Lest he through deceit waste the gifts given unto the poor brethren

questions.text: What qualifications must deacons possess according to 1 Timothy 3:8?

options.text: Abounding in great worldly possessions, and honoured by all secular magistrates
Unlearned in holy scriptures, yet highly esteemed among the gentile multitude
Grave, not doubletongued, not given to much wine, not greedy of filthy lucre
Advanced in years, but novices in the faith, and walking after carnal desires

questions.text: What is the church of the living God called in 1 Timothy 3:15?

options.text: The refuge of the gentile kingdoms
The earthly assembly of philosophers
The earthly temple of worldly wisdom
The pillar and ground of the truth

questions.text: What does the Spirit speak expressly concerning the latter times (1 Timothy 4:1)?

options.text: That some shall depart from the faith, giving heed to seducing spirits
That all men upon earth shall straightway acknowledge the saving truth
That the temple at Jerusalem shall be rebuilt to gather all nations
That the whole world shall enter into perpetual peace and cease from war

questions.text: What false commandments are described in 1 Timothy 4:3?

options.text: Commanding to be circumcised and enforcing temple ceremonies
Forbidding to marry, and commanding to abstain from meats
Forbidding all prayer and commanding anger in the assemblies
Demanding unlawful tenths and observing pagan rituals daily

questions.text: How is every creature of God sanctified according to 1 Timothy 4:5?

options.text: By washings in a sacred river
By the decree of worldly rulers
By the word of God and prayer
By offerings of silver and gold

questions.text: What difference is set between bodily exercise and godliness (1 Timothy 4:8)?

options.text: Bodily exercise yieldeth eternal reward, whereas godliness profiteth not at all
Both are of equal temporal profit unto man in his present pilgrimage upon earth
Godliness weakeneth the outward man, while bodily exercise perfecteth the soul
Bodily exercise profiteth little: but godliness is profitable unto all things

questions.text: In what things should Timothy be an example of the believers (1 Timothy 4:12)?

options.text: In word, in conversation, in charity, in spirit, in faith, in purity
In earthly riches, in worldly power, in great honor, and in authority
In contending before civil courts, in dispute, and in secular decrees
In severe fasting, in perpetual silence, and in rigorous bodily neglect

questions.text: How should an elder be treated according to 1 Timothy 5:1?

options.text: Rebuke him openly before all men that he may see his error
Rebuke not an elder, but intreat him as a loving father
Cast him out of the church until he make public confession
Pass him by in silence lest he be further stirred up to anger

questions.text: Who should learn first to shew piety at home and requite their parents (1 Timothy 5:4)?

options.text: The civil magistrates
Foreign travel companions
Her children or nephews
Only the city elders

questions.text: How is a man described who provideth not for his own (1 Timothy 5:8)?

options.text: He is accounted weak in the flesh, yet worthy of gentle forbearance
He ought to be brought before civil rulers and punished by the law
He loseth only earthly gain, but remaineth blameless in the faith
He hath denied the faith, and is worse than an infidel in judgment

questions.text: What are elders that rule well counted worthy of according to 1 Timothy 5:17?

options.text: Worthy of double honour
Worthy of single honour
Worthy of temporal fame
Worthy of worldly praise

questions.text: Before whom may an accusation against an elder be received (1 Timothy 5:19)?

options.text: Immediately upon any single private rumour
Only before two or three credible witnesses
After the approval of the Roman governor
Never under any manner of outward charges

questions.text: When is godliness great gain according to 1 Timothy 6:6?

options.text: When accompanied with abundant worldly treasures
When all earthly rulers praise it continually
When it is joined together with contentment
When it bringeth forth earthly dominion over men

questions.text: What is the root of all evil according to 1 Timothy 6:10?

options.text: Utter poverty
Bitter malice
Manual labour
Love of money

questions.text: What is Timothy exhorted to do in the fight of faith (1 Timothy 6:12)?

options.text: Fight the good fight of faith, lay hold on eternal life
Build a strong fortress in Ephesus to shelter the assembly
Flee from every adversary and seek refuge in the wilderness
Lay up treasures of gold and silver for coming tribulations

questions.text: What is charged upon them that are rich in this world in 1 Timothy 6:17?

options.text: That they cease from labour and live quietly upon their temporal wealth
That they be not highminded, nor trust in uncertain riches, but in God
That they give up their possessions to civil rulers for protection
That they withdraw from the needy lest their earthly treasure fail

questions.text: What is Timothy charged to keep and what to avoid (1 Timothy 6:20)?

options.text: Keep the treasures of gold and avoid the idol temples of Asia
Keep the Roman statutes and avoid the disputations of pagans
Keep that committed to thy trust, avoiding profane vain babblings
Keep the riches of the wealthy and avoid the reproach of rulers
